text:
IncidentBot: PIR created for INC-2026-042 after the paging storm last night. Please nominate a facilitator, confirm attendees, and volunteer a shadow/note-taker. Pre-read + logs: https://redwood/incident/INC-2026-042 :spiral_notepad:
Maya Rivera: :wave: I can facilitate if the time works. Traveling Wed afternoon PT though.
Devon K: I can attend. Would be good to have infra and support represented.
Samir Patel: Thu morning works for me (UTC+1). 09:00 UTC is probably best to hit both EU morning + NA late-afternoon.
Lina Chen: Happy to shadow and take notes. I can also run the mitigation timeline slide with Maya beforehand.
AJ: If Maya ends up not being available, I can step in as facilitator. Also happy to own the postmortem write-up structure.
Maya Rivera: I'll take it — Lina shadowing. Devon, Samir, AJ please RSVP. I'll create the calendar invite once we lock the slot.
Devon K: Quick timezone check: 09:00 UTC = 02:00 PT? Wait, math brain fail. Let me re-check. That might be 02:00 PT, so probably too early for US west.
Samir Patel: 09:00 UTC = 10:00 CET, 05:00 PT? Hmm okay maybe pick a slightly later UTC time to include NA. How about 13:00 UTC?
Devon K: 13:00 UTC = 06:00 PT — still rough. Suggest 16:00 UTC (09:00 PT) or 15:00 UTC (08:00 PT).
Maya Rivera: 16:00 UTC / 09:00 PT might be the best compromise. Who's blocked?
AJ: 09:00 PT works for me.
Samir Patel: 16:00 UTC is late afternoon here (17:00 CET) but OK.
Devon K: 16:00 UTC works.
IncidentBot: Poll created: https://doodle.redwood/polls/INC-2026-042-timeslot — current tallies: 16:00 UTC (3), 09:00 UTC (1), Thu 18:00 UTC (0). Use the poll or react with emoji to confirm.
Maya Rivera: Ok locking on 16:00 UTC (09:00 PT). Agenda: 1) timeline & visible impact 2) RCA candidates 3) remediation/actions 4) communications. 60m.
Lina Chen: I'll prep the timeline slides and notes. Will sync with Maya for 30m dry-run day prior.
Devon K: I'll own the infra follow-up: autoscaler tuning + capacity thresholds. Assigning to me.
Samir Patel: I'll pull and attach traces and span-level artifacts to the postmortem doc before the meeting.
AJ: I'll draft the postmortem structure in the doc and prep the action-item table for tracking.
Maya Rivera: Action owners (please ack): infra tuning -> Devon; tracing + root-cause artifacts -> Samir; comms draft + notes -> Lina; write-up framework -> AJ. Also adding a new canary mirror task to validate the mitigation; owner = Devon. Please ack here.
Devon K: Ack. Will draft tuning plan and canary steps.
Samir Patel: Ack. Will attach trace export and sampling script.
Lina Chen: Ack. I'll draft comms + take notes.
AJ: Ack. Will prep the write-up template and sync with legal if necessary.
OpsBot: Reminder: attach runbook excerpts and any paged logs to the postmortem doc. Template link: https://redwood/templates/postmortem.md
Maya Rivera: Thanks — I'll post the invite for Thu 16:00 UTC (60m) and share the pre-read snapshot by EOD PT. Lina and I will do a quick 30m dry-run Wed 16:30 PT. Anyone else want to shadow the facilitation for training purposes?
Samir Patel: I can join the dry-run for 15 minutes to go over traces.
Devon K: Probably won't make the dry-run, but will review materials.
Maya Rivera: Great. Summary: facilitator = Maya Rivera; shadow/note-taker = Lina Chen; attendees = Devon K, Samir Patel, AJ + support/eng leads; invite + agenda arriving EOD. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
IncidentBot: Logged facilitator=Maya Rivera, shadow=Lina Chen, scheduled=2136552000 (Thu 16:00 UTC). Marking PIR status: scheduled.
